name: Community stability
description: How much a subject's community changes between its samples. Dissimilarity between consecutive samples of the same subject (Bray-Curtis on relative abundance or Jaccard on presence) against the time gap between them, per group, with the dissimilarity between different subjects as the baseline.

inputs.label: Taxon profiles (long)
inputs.description: One row per taxon per sample with read counts; subject and timepoint roles order each subject's samples. A group role keeps comparisons within a group and colours the figures.

metric.title: Dissimilarity
metric.description: Bray-Curtis on relative abundance or Jaccard on presence.

within_group_only.title: Compare within a group only
within_group_only.description: Pair a subject's samples only when they share the group value (for example the same specimen type).

max_gap.title: Maximum time gap
max_gap.description: Pairs further apart than this many timepoint units are left out; 0 keeps every pair.

rank.title: Taxonomic rank
rank.description: When the table maps a rank role, use taxa of this rank only.

min_reads.title: Minimum reads per sample
min_reads.description: Samples with fewer retained reads are dropped; 0 keeps every sample.

remove_artifacts.title: Remove curated artifacts
remove_artifacts.description: Drop taxa on curation lists with the artifact role first.

outputs.name: sample_pairs
outputs.description: Every pair of samples of the same subject: times, gap, dissimilarity and whether the two are consecutive.

outputs.name: subject_stability
outputs.description: Per subject (and group): samples, consecutive pairs, median and maximum dissimilarity, median gap.

outputs.name: turnover_vs_gap
outputs.description: Dissimilarity between consecutive samples against the time gap, per group, with running medians and the between-subject baseline.

outputs.name: stability_by_group
outputs.description: Within-subject dissimilarity next to the between-subject baseline, per group.

citation: Built with pandas, NumPy, SciPy (Virtanen et al. 2020) and Plotly. Bray-Curtis dissimilarity (Bray and Curtis 1957), Jaccard index (Jaccard 1901), Spearman rank correlation. See README.md.
